# Stand-in answer key

A made-up paragraph so the five-word overlap check has something to compare against: the lighthouse keeper counted seagulls every morning before breakfast.

Made-up items, so a dry round can be graded end to end (`tests/scripts/study-round-e2e.spec.ts`):

- A1 the lighthouse lamp is lit from a room far below it
- A2 the tide table sits behind the keeper's door
- B1 a known gap: the foghorn sounds twice on one press
